fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami hosting major conventions (Shriners and the 64th Elks meeting), civic hospitality and economic impact; discussion of the Coral Gables Corporation’s financial situation and concerns about bankruptcy and investor confidence; city matters including dock rental negotiations with the Clyde Line Steamship Company, local printing contracts, dry-cleaning competition, and municipal budget cuts and public services. Additional pieces cover Miami transportation and streetcar service, police training, Prohibition-era liquor prices and enforcement, entertainment listings, and letters to the editor regarding a proposed “district,” street railway safety, Coral Gables leadership, and public funding for the Miami baseball club.
